sources.text:
入国審査時には「外国人入国記録」をご提出ください
外国人入国記録（EDカード）
日本に新規入国する全ての外国人の方に対し、「外国人入国記録（EDカード）」の提出を求めています。
出入国在留管理庁では、入国審査の際に提出する外国人入国記録（EDカード）について、スムーズな入国手続きのため、「Visit Japan Web」を利用して電子的に提出することを推奨しています。
※入国審査官による入国審査を受ける必要があります。
対象者
新規入国する外国人
※再入国（みなし再入国含む）、特例上陸、日米地位協定該当者（SOFA）、国連軍地位協定該当者及び円滑化協定対象者（RAA）の方は、利用対象外です。
紙媒体の外国人入国記録（EDカード）
外国人入国記録（EDカード）の電子的な提出の対象者の方であっても、スマートフォン等の操作に不慣れな場合などには、紙媒体の「外国人入国記録」を提出してください。

sources.title: Declaration of Accompanied Articles and Unaccompanied Articles
sources.text:
Declaration of Accompanied Articles and Unaccompanied Articles
Japan Customs requires all passengers entering Japan to submit a Declaration of Accompanied Articles and Unaccompanied Articles in order to prevent terrorism and smuggling, and to ensure prompt and proper customs clearance.
In addition, Japan Customs recommends submitting declarations electronically via the “Visit Japan Web” .
The existing paper version of the Customs Declaration Form can still be used, and can also be printed out (on A4 sized paper) in advance.

法務大臣閣議後記者会見の概要
令和８年８月２８日（金）
法務省及び入管庁の概算要求に関する質疑について
【大臣】
今回の骨太の方針では、在留許可手数料の見直しや電子渡航認証制度、いわゆるＪＥＳＴＡの導入による手数料収入により確保した財源を最大限活用しつつ、従来の考え方にとらわれずに必要な措置を講じて、外国人政策を総合的かつ強力に進める、手数料引上げの趣旨に鑑み、優先して、出入国在留管理庁の人的・物的体制を抜本的に強化し、ＪＥＳＴＡの２０２８年度中の導入に向けた準備作業やＤＸの推進による審査の迅速化・高度化を進めるほか、「不法滞在者ゼロプラン」を強力に推進するなど、出入国在留管理の一層の適正化を図ることとされております。

raw_guidance.passport_validity: Valid for the entire intended stay in Japan
required_documents: Schedule of stay / travel itinerary in Japan
Proof of financial means (e.g. bank statements, salary slips)
raw_guidance.processing_time: Approximately 5-7 working days at the mission after the designated agency submits the application; additional agency processing time applies
raw_guidance.photo_requirements: One recent colour photograph, generally 45 mm × 45 mm, plain white/off-white background, taken within the last 6 months; confirm exact size with the agency/embassy
payment_process: Pay the 3,000 JPY government visa fee plus the authorised travel agency's service charge directly to the agency
submission_process: Prepare documents according to the Japanese Embassy/Consulate-General checklist
Submit the application and passport to an authorised travel agency in Vietnam
The agency lodges the application at the Japanese Embassy/Consulate-General
Collect the passport and visa from the agency once notified
raw_guidance.onward_travel_evidence: Return or onward flight reservation/itinerary showing departure from Japan
raw_guidance.accommodation_evidence: Hotel bookings covering the stay, or an invitation letter plus guarantor documents if staying with a resident
raw_guidance.financial_evidence: Recent 3–6 months bank statements, proof of employment/income, and tax documents if applicable
exceptions: The Embassy/Consulate-General does not accept individual walk-in applications; only designated authorised travel agencies may lodge
Multiple-entry visas are not guaranteed and require proof of stable income and/or previous travel to Japan or other G7 countries
Transit without a visa may be possible for same-calendar-day connections through the same airport; confirm with the airline

uncertainty.reason: The 3,000 JPY figure is the standard single-entry short-stay visa fee; multiple-entry visas cost 6,000 JPY, and the agency may also charge a separate service fee.
A consular interview is not standard but may be requested at the mission's discretion in individual cases.
Although the single-entry short-stay category allows up to 90 days, the actual granted stay is determined by the mission based on the submitted itinerary.
